title: Alpha and Beta Testing — Overview
summary: Alpha: internal testing; Beta: external users testing pre-release versions in real conditions.
body:
Alpha: internal testing; Beta: external users testing pre-release versions in real conditions. Standard pre-release practice.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include UAT, Dogfooding, Release Testing.
